name: One-line Song pastoral scene presets
rule: Explicit user details override every preset field.

presets.setting: 带开放木窗的泥砖灶间

shot.zh: 平视中景，人物位于右侧三分区
shot.en: eye-level medium shot, figure on the right third

presets.default_time: 清晨窗光或日落前侧光

relation.zh: 右手木铲翻动铁锅青菜，左手稳定锅柄
relation.en: right hand turns greens with a wooden spatula while the left steadies the wok handle

motion.zh: 菜叶沿木铲短暂抬起，蒸汽从锅上方扩散
motion.en: greens lift along the spatula and steam diffuses above the wok

shot.zh: 灶台高度中景，人物侧面
shot.en: stove-height medium shot in profile

relation.zh: 一手揭开陶锅盖，一手扶住锅沿
relation.en: one hand lifts the clay lid while the other steadies the pot rim

motion.zh: 锅盖开启方向带出一束柔软蒸汽
motion.en: a soft plume of steam follows the opening lid

presets.setting: 白墙乡居的深色木窗旁

shot.zh: 人物偏右的中近景，左侧窗格前景
shot.en: medium-close frame with the figure right of center and lattice foreground on the left

relation.zh: 双手在膝前稳稳托住粗陶茶壶
relation.en: both hands balance a rough earthenware teapot near the lap

motion.zh: 茶汽上升，碎发和袖缘被横向微风轻轻带起
motion.en: tea steam rises while loose hair and sleeve edges follow a mild cross breeze

shot.zh: 隔着枝叶观察的宽幅群像
shot.en: wide group view observed through layered leaves

relation.zh: 一人倒茶，两人举杯回应，一人侧身倾听
relation.en: one pours tea, two answer with cups, and one turns to listen

motion.zh: 细茶汽、轻微手势与树叶微动共同维持安静节奏
motion.en: fine tea steam, small gestures, and leaf movement share a quiet rhythm

presets.setting: 白墙与花圃相接的院角

shot.zh: 正面平视胸像特写
shot.en: frontal eye-level chest-up close view

relation.zh: 双手倾斜粗陶水罐，视线落向壶口与花草
relation.en: both hands tilt a rough clay water jar while her gaze follows the spout toward the flowers

motion.zh: 连续水流穿过下方前景，在花叶处形成细小飞溅
motion.en: a continuous stream crosses the lower foreground and breaks into small splashes on the leaves

presets.foreground: 少量柔焦花朵，不遮挡脸和水流

presets.setting: 长白墙旁的竹竿晾晒处

shot.zh: 四分之三侧后方全身镜头
shot.en: three-quarter rear full-body environmental shot

relation.zh: 双臂抬起把湿润素布搭上竹竿
relation.en: both arms lift damp plain cloth over a bamboo pole

motion.zh: 湿布先下坠再被微风轻推，水滴从最低褶皱落下
motion.en: damp cloth hangs with weight before the breeze moves it, droplets falling from the lowest folds

presets.foreground: 一片柔焦白布从画面侧缘进入

presets.setting: 村屋下方的浅溪与踏石

shot.zh: 水面高度的双人环境镜头
shot.en: water-level two-person environmental shot

relation.zh: 前景女子双手漂洗菜叶，后方女子提起滴水菜束放入竹篮
relation.en: the foreground woman rinses leaves with both hands while the rear woman lifts dripping greens into a basket

motion.zh: 水滴从叶尖落下并在浅溪形成同心涟漪
motion.en: droplets fall from leaf tips into concentric ripples

shot.zh: 平视中远景，湿布形成对角线
shot.en: eye-level medium-wide shot with damp cloth forming a diagonal

relation.zh: 一人在石台漂洗，另一人反向拧出长布水分
relation.en: one rinses cloth at the stone ledge while the other twists the long fabric in the opposite direction

motion.zh: 湿布下坠，成股水线沿最低褶皱落入溪中
motion.en: heavy damp cloth sags as narrow streams fall from its lowest folds

shot.zh: 宽幅环境群像，低视点贴近水面
shot.en: wide environmental group shot from a low viewpoint near the water

relation.zh: 前景女子分秧并插入水田，两位同伴沿不同田行继续劳作
relation.en: the foreground woman divides and plants seedlings while two companions work along separate rows

motion.zh: 手指入水产生小涟漪，湿裙边贴近小腿
motion.en: fingers entering the water create small ripples while damp hems cling near the calves

shot.zh: 透过作物前景的低位宽景
shot.en: low wide shot through softly blurred crop foreground

relation.zh: 一人用镰刀割取禾秆，另一人把收下的禾束捆紧
relation.en: one cuts stalks with a sickle while the other binds the gathered sheaves

motion.zh: 割下作物沿镰刀方向倒伏，发丝和稻叶同向移动
motion.en: cut stalks fall along the sickle path while hair and leaves share one breeze

shot.zh: 低机位宽景，谷粒占据下方前景
shot.en: low wide shot with grain filling the lower foreground

relation.zh: 前景女子用木耙翻谷，中景女子倾倒竹筛，后景女子整理晒席
relation.en: the foreground woman rakes grain, the middle woman pours from a bamboo sieve, and the rear woman straightens the drying mat

motion.zh: 较重谷粒近处落下，细壳与谷尘在逆光中稍远飘散
motion.en: heavier grain falls nearby while light chaff and dust drift farther in backlight

presets.foreground: 清晰谷粒与浅景深过渡

presets.setting: 沿山坡弯曲延伸的茶垄

shot.zh: 宽幅环境群像，前景人物侧面中景
shot.en: wide environmental group with a profile picker in the near middle plane

relation.zh: 前景女子指腹轻摘嫩芽，三位同伴沿不同茶垄向远处递进
relation.en: the foreground woman pinches a tender bud while three companions recede along separate tea rows

motion.zh: 茶叶露珠轻闪，背篓随身体前倾产生重量感
motion.en: dew glints on tea leaves while the back basket carries the weight of her forward lean

presets.foreground: 柔焦茶叶占据画框一侧

presets.setting: 层叠桑叶围合的林间小路

shot.zh: 叶隙间的平视中宽景
shot.en: eye-level medium-wide view through layered mulberry leaves

relation.zh: 中央女子托住桑枝挑选嫩叶，两位同伴分处前后景采摘
relation.en: the central woman supports a branch to select young leaves while two companions pick in separate depth planes

motion.zh: 枝条松开后缓慢回弹，近景叶片随微风轻动
motion.en: released branches return slowly while near leaves move in a mild breeze

presets.setting: 竹匾层叠的通风养蚕房

shot.zh: 桌面高度双人中景
shot.en: table-height two-person medium shot

relation.zh: 一人把桑叶铺入竹匾，另一人轻轻整理蚕匾边缘
relation.en: one spreads mulberry leaves across a bamboo tray while the other gently arranges the tray edge

motion.zh: 叶片落下并自然重叠，衣袖在竹匾上方保持轻柔
motion.en: leaves settle into natural overlaps while sleeves move gently above the tray

shot.zh: 平视中全景，保留篮筐与抬手动作
shot.en: eye-level medium-full shot retaining the basket and raised hand

relation.zh: 一手扶住藤蔓，另一手摘下豆荚，竹篮贴近腰侧
relation.en: one hand steadies the vine while the other picks a bean pod, with the basket held near the waist

motion.zh: 藤蔓受力轻弯，豆荚落入篮中
motion.en: the vine bends slightly under contact as the pod drops into the basket

shot.zh: 从藤架下方轻微仰拍的双人中景
shot.en: gently low two-person medium shot beneath the trellis

relation.zh: 前景女子双手托住葫芦，另一女子扶篮并抬头观察藤蒂
relation.en: the foreground woman supports the gourd with both hands while her companion holds the basket and watches the stem

motion.zh: 葫芦保持重量，藤蔓与叶片随手部受力轻动
motion.en: the gourd retains weight as the vine and leaves respond to the hands

shot.zh: 水面低机位，小舟沿对角线延伸
shot.en: water-level view with the skiff running diagonally

relation.zh: 前景女子折取莲蓬，后方女子用长篙稳定小舟
relation.en: the foreground woman gathers a lotus pod while the rear woman steadies the skiff with a long pole

motion.zh: 折断荷梗滴水，船篙推水产生与舟身一致的波纹
motion.en: the broken stem drips while the pole creates ripples aligned with the skiff

presets.foreground: 大块柔焦荷叶遮挡画框下缘

shot.zh: 轻微仰拍的全身环境镜头
shot.en: gently low full-body environmental shot

relation.zh: 一手提装饭竹篮，另一手提小口陶壶，脚步沿田埂前行
relation.en: one hand carries a meal basket and the other a narrow clay flask as she walks the ridge

motion.zh: 篮筐随步伐轻摆，发丝与裙摆沿同一风向滞后
motion.en: the basket swings with her steps while hair and skirt trail in one breeze

presets.setting: 遮阴木棚下的石磨工作台

shot.zh: 桌面高度双人中景
shot.en: table-height two-person medium shot

relation.zh: 一人双手推动磨杆，另一人向磨眼加豆并扶住接浆陶碗
relation.en: one pushes the mill handle with both hands while the other feeds beans and steadies the catching bowl

motion.zh: 上盘随磨杆旋转，豆浆从石槽连续流入陶碗
motion.en: the upper stone turns with the handle as soy milk runs continuously into the clay bowl

shot.zh: 侧面中宽景，保留木杵完整行程
shot.en: profile medium-wide shot retaining the full pestle movement

relation.zh: 一人垂直抬落木杵，另一人跪坐在安全距离整理谷物
relation.en: one raises and lowers the pestle vertically while the other sorts grain from a safe distance

motion.zh: 木杵沿垂直线起落，细粉只在石臼口附近扬起
motion.en: the pestle travels vertically while fine dust rises only near the mortar mouth

shot.zh: 斜侧面中景，手、木梭和经线清楚
shot.en: oblique medium shot with hands, shuttle, and warp clearly visible

relation.zh: 一手送出木梭，另一手整理绷紧经线
relation.en: one hand passes the shuttle while the other arranges the taut warp

motion.zh: 木梭横向穿行，经线产生细微连续震动
motion.en: the shuttle crosses laterally and the warp threads vibrate faintly

shot.zh: 平视中宽景，人物分处染缸两侧
shot.en: eye-level medium-wide shot with figures on opposite sides of the dye vat

relation.zh: 两人分别托住长布两端，将湿布从陶缸中提起
relation.en: the two women hold opposite ends of a long cloth and lift it from the clay vat

motion.zh: 湿布带重量下垂，染液从最低折痕滴回缸中
motion.en: the heavy wet cloth sags as dye drips from its lowest folds back into the vat

shot.zh: 俯视感轻微的手部中近景
shot.en: slightly elevated medium-close view centered on the hands

relation.zh: 双手把细竹篾交错压入篮壁
relation.en: both hands press thin bamboo strips into the interlaced basket wall

motion.zh: 竹篾在指尖受力弯曲并恢复弧度
motion.en: bamboo strips bend under fingertip pressure and settle into a curve

shot.zh: 侧面中景，网线在双手之间清楚展开
shot.en: profile medium shot with net cord clearly spread between both hands

relation.zh: 一手拉紧网目，另一手把麻线穿过破口打结
relation.en: one hand tensions the mesh while the other threads hemp cord through the tear

motion.zh: 网面随拉力形成明确张力线，水面在背景轻微晃动
motion.en: the net forms clear tension lines while background water moves softly

presets.setting: 竹林与村屋之间的土路

shot.zh: 侧后方全身环境镜头
shot.en: three-quarter rear full-body environmental shot

relation.zh: 双手整理背篓中的短柴并沿土路归家
relation.en: both hands steady short firewood in a back basket while she walks home

motion.zh: 背篓贴合肩背，步伐带动衣摆轻微滞后
motion.en: the loaded basket rests against the shoulders while the hem trails behind each step

shot.zh: 低位中宽景，竹竿形成竖向框架
shot.en: low medium-wide view with bamboo trunks forming vertical framing

relation.zh: 前景女子用窄锄松土，后方同伴把挖出的春笋放入竹篮
relation.en: the foreground woman loosens soil with a narrow hoe while her companion places shoots into a basket

motion.zh: 湿土沿锄刃散开，竹叶滴水但不形成浓雾
motion.en: damp soil parts along the hoe blade while bamboo leaves drip without heavy mist

presets.setting: 果树投影覆盖的白墙院落

shot.zh: 平视宽景，晾架与竹匾形成前后关系
shot.en: eye-level wide shot with drying rack and bamboo trays in separate planes

relation.zh: 一人跪坐排列竹匾柿子，另一人把成串柿子挂上竹架
relation.en: one kneels to arrange persimmons on trays while the other hangs fruit strings from a bamboo rack

motion.zh: 果串随手部抬起轻摆，落叶只在地面附近移动
motion.en: fruit strings sway as they are lifted while fallen leaves move close to the ground

presets.foreground: 柔焦橙红果实作为克制暖点

shot.zh: 平视中近景，人物蹲在菜畦边
shot.en: eye-level medium-close shot with the figure crouched beside the herb bed

relation.zh: 一手托住香草茎，另一手用小刀剪取嫩枝
relation.en: one hand supports the herb stems while the other cuts tender sprigs with a small knife

motion.zh: 湿叶轻触衣袖，露珠从剪下枝叶落入篮中
motion.en: wet leaves brush the sleeve and dew falls from cut sprigs into the basket

shot.zh: 庭院宽景，人物位于上下两个层次
shot.en: courtyard wide shot with the figures on two vertical levels

relation.zh: 上方女子扶稳低梯整理松动瓦片，下方同伴双手递上备用瓦
relation.en: the upper woman steadies herself on a low ladder to reset a tile while her companion passes a replacement from below

motion.zh: 檐滴仍在落下，递瓦动作保持清楚安全的距离
motion.en: eave droplets still fall while the tile handoff keeps a clear safe distance

shot.zh: 宽幅环境镜头，人物与鸭群沿溪岸行进
shot.en: wide environmental shot with the figure and ducks moving along the bank

relation.zh: 女子持细竹竿在鸭群后方缓慢引导
relation.en: the woman carries a slender bamboo stick and guides the flock from behind

motion.zh: 鸭群留下连续水纹，人物衣摆沿相同方向移动
motion.en: the flock leaves continuous ripples while her hem follows the same travel direction

shot.zh: 水面低位双人中宽景
shot.en: low two-person medium-wide view near the water

relation.zh: 前景女子双手探入浅水，另一人扶住半浸水的竹鱼篮
relation.en: the foreground woman searches the shallow water with both hands while her companion steadies a half-submerged fish basket

motion.zh: 手部搅起小片浑水和细密涟漪，篮筐承接水流
motion.en: the hands stir a small cloud of silt and fine ripples while the basket catches the flow

presets.setting: 木窗紧闭的冬夜起居间

shot.zh: 桌边中近景，油灯与双手形成视觉三角
shot.en: table-side medium-close view with oil lamp and hands forming a visual triangle

relation.zh: 一手转动木纺锤，另一手控制纤维张力
relation.en: one hand turns the wooden spindle while the other controls fiber tension

motion.zh: 纺锤平稳旋转，灯焰轻颤，背景保持安静深蓝灰
motion.en: the spindle turns steadily, the lamp flame trembles lightly, and the background remains quiet blue gray

shot.zh: 侧面全身中宽景
shot.en: profile medium-wide full-body shot

relation.zh: 双手拉动粗绳，让木桶从井口上升
relation.en: both hands pull the coarse rope as the wooden bucket rises from the well

motion.zh: 绳索绷紧，桶沿滴水，人物身体后倾形成可信受力
motion.en: the rope pulls taut, the bucket drips, and her body leans back under believable load

shot.zh: 宽幅侧面环境镜头
shot.en: wide profile environmental shot

relation.zh: 前景女子从布袋均匀撒种，后方同伴用木耙轻覆田土
relation.en: the foreground woman broadcasts seed from a cloth bag while her companion covers the soil lightly with a wooden rake

motion.zh: 种子形成克制弧线，耙齿只扰动表层湿土
motion.en: seed forms a restrained arc while rake tines disturb only the top layer of damp soil

shot.zh: 桌面高度三人中景
shot.en: table-height three-person medium shot

relation.zh: 三人分别剥豆、接豆与整理豆荚，动作互不重复
relation.en: the three women shell pods, catch beans, and sort husks in distinct gestures

motion.zh: 豆粒落入陶碗，空豆荚堆在竹匾一侧
motion.en: beans fall into a clay bowl while empty pods gather on one side of a bamboo tray

presets.setting: 木棚下的石磨与压豆腐木案

shot.zh: 中宽景，石磨与木案分居前后层
shot.en: medium-wide shot with millstone and pressing table on separate depth planes

relation.zh: 前景女子收拢滤布，后方女子把石块稳放在压板中央
relation.en: the foreground woman gathers the filter cloth while her companion centers a stone weight on the pressing board

motion.zh: 豆浆从布边缓慢滴落，木板在石块重量下轻微下压
motion.en: soy milk drips slowly from the cloth as the board settles beneath the stone weight

presets.setting: 面向湿润庭院的狭长屋檐

shot.zh: 从室内阴影向外看的双人中宽景
shot.en: medium-wide two-person view from interior shadow toward the wet courtyard

relation.zh: 两人并坐，一人递出热茶，另一人双手接杯看向雨幕
relation.en: the two sit side by side as one offers hot tea and the other receives the cup while watching the rain

motion.zh: 檐滴连续落下，茶汽在冷湿空气中短暂可见
motion.en: eave drops fall continuously while tea steam appears briefly in the cool damp air

shot.zh: 侧后方宽幅全身镜头
shot.en: wide three-quarter rear full-body shot

relation.zh: 前方女子背着装满作物的竹篓，后方同伴提着小篮沿路交谈
relation.en: the leading woman carries a full back basket while her companion follows with a smaller basket in quiet conversation

motion.zh: 沉重背篓稳定贴背，步伐让衣摆和碎发轻微滞后
motion.en: the loaded basket stays firm against the back while hems and loose hair trail behind the steps
